title: Samuel Wines (Director, CoLabs Australia) is designing a steward-owned venture studio around the book — 'a mission guardian trust with real veto power'
summary: Samuel Wines, co-founder and director of CoLabs Australia, read Incorruptible alongside Samin H. of Melbourne Bionics and turned it into a podcast episode and a concrete structure: a four-entity design with a holding company, an operating company with employee profit share, a mission guardian trust holding real veto power, and an open research entity. He says it is the shape of a steward-owned venture studio CoLabs is building toward.
blockquote:
In this conversation, we dig into how you design a company that can't be pushed off course.

The centrepiece: a four-entity structure built on steward ownership principles – holding company, operating company with employee profit share, a mission guardian trust with real veto power, and an open research entity.

source_urls.label: Incorruptible by design: What if Governance is the Real Innovation? ft. Samin Haque
